title: Agent Collaboration Gaps — Specialist Delegation Enforcement
description: Close five remaining bypasses where non-specialist agents call Cloudflare Docs MCP or GitHub Octokit directly instead of going through CloudflareAgent / GithubAgent. Add a guardrail that makes the bypass impossible to reintroduce. Codify CoordinatorAgent's pure-router contract.

tasks.title: Add searchRepositories and searchCode @callable to GithubAgent
tasks.description: Create methods/search.ts exporting searchRepositoriesImpl(agent, args) and searchCodeImpl(agent, args) that wrap getOctokitAsUser(env).search.repos(...) and .search.code(...). In GithubAgent/index.ts add two @callable() methods that dynamic-import and delegate to the impls. Return raw data.items arrays — no normalization. Args: { query: string; perPage?: number; page?: number }. Preserve existing @callable pattern (dynamic import).
tasks.success_criteria: rg -n '@callable' src/backend/src/ai/agents/backend/GithubAgent | grep -E 'searchRepositories|searchCode' returns 2 matches. npx tsc --noEmit passes.

tasks.title: GuardrailAgent: drop local rewriteQuestionForMCP — pass raw question to CloudflareAgent
tasks.description: Delete lines ~99-102 (the agent.getAI().rewriteQuestionForMCP(...) call). Pass mcpQuestionBase directly into cloudflareAgent.agenticSearch(mcpQuestionBase, { files, rules }). CloudflareAgent rewrites internally. Preserve the try/catch graceful-degradation block and the logger info line about the base question. Do not touch the rest of the file.
tasks.success_criteria: rg -n 'rewriteQuestionForMCP' src/backend/src/ai/agents/backend/GuardrailAgent returns 0 lines of code (only the JSDoc comment at line 19 may remain — strip it in this edit). npx tsc --noEmit passes.

tasks.title: LearningAgent: drop local rewriteQuestionForMCP — pass raw question to CloudflareAgent
tasks.description: Delete lines ~53-59 (the `let rewritten = mcpQuery;` block and its try/catch). Replace the existing cloudflareAgent.agenticSearch(rewritten) call with cloudflareAgent.agenticSearch(mcpQuery). Preserve the outer try/catch that provides graceful degradation when the peer is unreachable.
tasks.success_criteria: rg -n 'rewriteQuestionForMCP' src/backend/src/ai/agents/backend/LearningAgent returns 0 matches. npx tsc --noEmit passes.

tasks.title: OrchestratorAgent: route reverse-engineering MCP call through CloudflareAgent
tasks.description: Remove the `import { queryMCP } from '@/ai/mcp/mcp-client';` at line 18. Replace the direct queryMCP(...) call at line ~113 with `const cloudflareAgent = (agent as any).getPeerAgent((env as any).CLOUDFLARE_AGENT); cloudflareDocs = await cloudflareAgent.agenticSearch(query);` wrapped in try/catch with a warn-log fallback (cloudflareDocs = null). Reference graceful-degradation pattern from backend/GuardrailAgent/methods/cloudflare-docs.ts:107-118.
tasks.success_criteria: rg -n 'queryMCP' src/backend/src/ai/agents/backend/OrchestratorAgent returns 0 matches. npx tsc --noEmit passes.

tasks.title: ResearchAgent: consume GithubAgent.searchRepositories instead of direct Octokit
tasks.description: Remove the dynamic import `const { getOctokit } = await import('@services/octokit/core');` and the subsequent direct octokit.search.repos(...) call. Replace with `const githubAgent = (agent as any).getPeerAgent((agent as any).env.GITHUB_AGENT); const items = await githubAgent.searchRepositories({ query, perPage: opts?.perPage ?? 20 });`. Wrap in try/catch returning [] on failure. Do not re-export Octokit anywhere in ResearchAgent.
tasks.success_criteria: rg -n '@octokit|getOctokit|new Octokit' src/backend/src/ai/agents/backend/ResearchAgent returns 0 matches. npx tsc --noEmit passes.

tasks.title: Audit CloudflareAgent.agenticSearch signature consistency
tasks.description: Confirm agenticSearch(question: string, context?: Record<string, any>) matches every caller's shape after P2 fixes. The signature must tolerate callers that pass no context (LearningAgent diagnose-health, OrchestratorAgent reverse-engineering) AND callers that pass structured context (GuardrailAgent). If today's signature requires context, update to accept context?:, treat undefined as empty, and do not throw. Audit only — implement a fix only if a mismatch is detected.
tasks.success_criteria: All four callers compile. Calling agenticSearch with just a question string (no context) completes successfully in a smoke test. npx tsc --noEmit passes.

tasks.title: Add path-scoped no-restricted-imports overrides
tasks.description: Add three ESLint overrides: (1) agents outside chat/CloudflareAgent/ may not import @/ai/mcp/*; (2) agents outside backend/GithubAgent/ may not import @octokit/*, @services/octokit/*, @/services/octokit/*; (3) chat/CoordinatorAgent/ may not import @octokit/*, @/ai/mcp/*, @/cloudflare/*, @services/*, @/services/*. Include a helpful `message` on each rule pointing at PRD.md. Also create .agent/rules/agent-specialist-delegation.md explaining the rule in prose for LLM-driven PRs. If the project does not use ESLint, omit .eslintrc.cjs and encode the rule only in .agent/rules/.
tasks.success_criteria: npx eslint src/backend/src/ai/agents passes with no errors. Introducing a test bypass (e.g. temporarily adding `import { queryMCP } from '@/ai/mcp/mcp-client'` in backend/DesignAgent) produces a lint error.

tasks.title: Codify CoordinatorAgent's pure-router contract in a header comment
tasks.description: Add a JSDoc header block immediately above the CoordinatorAgent class declaration that names (1) the pure-router contract, (2) allowed imports, (3) forbidden import categories, (4) the rule that new functionality must be added as a @callable on the specialist first. Reference PRD.md C9 for enforcement details. Exact text provided in PROMPT.md §C9.
tasks.success_criteria: The header comment exists and references v7/PRD.md. The lint rule from P3-LINT-RULE flags any attempt to add a forbidden import.

tasks.title: Decide babysitter utility's MCP access strategy
tasks.description: The babysitter utility at services/planning/babysitter/utils.ts:47 calls queryMCP directly. It runs in a scheduled-worker context, not inside an agent DO. Pick one: (a) refactor to accept an agent instance (or a CloudflareAgent stub) and delegate via getPeerAgent(env.CLOUDFLARE_AGENT).agenticSearch(...); or (b) add an explicit eslint-disable-next-line comment and a prose justification explaining why this is the one sanctioned non-agent queryMCP call site. Do not leave the bypass undocumented.
tasks.success_criteria: Either the queryMCP call is gone (option a) or an inline comment + eslint-disable exists at the call site with a link to this PRD (option b).

tasks.title: Mark v5/followup A6 as superseded by v7 C1
tasks.description: In the A6 row of the Agent Refinements scope table in v5/followup/PRD.md, append to the 'What's Missing' cell: ' (Superseded by v7 C1 — see docs/20260417/standardize_agents/v7/PRD.md)'. No other edits.
tasks.success_criteria: rg -n 'Superseded by v7 C1' docs/20260417/standardize_agents/v5/followup/PRD.md returns 1 match.
